reviews.reason: 独立 Agent 评审完成；评分是基于本次证据的意见，不替代业务 QA 或人工评审。
reviews.summary: 本次独立评审针对制度与资料中心场景审阅 NocoBase3 内核/插件的 5 个能力单元：数据库迁移、服务端 API 契约、客户端路由与覆盖层、AI 知识库问答、授权与部门可见性。总体判断：迁移、API 契约与授权能力成熟且指引充分；AI 知识库强依赖外部 embedding/向量服务，在本环境不可用，需求以应用自建关键词检索绕行交付。历史调用 9 次共 88 个错误信号，均为工具/环境/探索噪声或已解决的试错，未见归因于框架缺陷者。未做图像视觉复核，故 UI 维度不评分。

modules.name: 数据库迁移与 Schema 声明（@nocobase/db）
modules.scope: 为制度与资料中心建立文档、版本、部门可见性与备份所需表结构，并保证迁移可重复、可诊断、可回滚。
modules.limitations: 仅审阅安装包 dist 产物与内置 Skill，未实际运行迁移或验证特定方言的 DDL。

requirements.need: 建立文档/版本/可见部门/备份等表结构
requirements.responsibility: 迁移文件是 schema 的唯一权威，defineMigration 与 CollectionBuilder 声明 Collection/字段/索引
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 database/<connection>/migrations 写自包含、合并后不可变的迁移，用 builder.createCollection 声明结构
requirements.actualUsage: app/database/main/migrations 使用 defineMigration + builder.createCollection 建表

requirements.responsibility: seed 与迁移职责分离，seed 用 repository.upsertOne 按稳定业务键幂等
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 seeds 目录幂等 upsert，重复执行不会重复插入
requirements.actualUsage: 应用使用 seeds 目录写入初始数据

requirements.need: 已执行迁移被改动时能被发现并修复
requirements.responsibility: checksum-history 记录并比对已执行迁移的校验和，渲染 nocobase db repair 指引
requirements.recommendedUsage: 合并后不改迁移，改动以新迁移修正；必要时 db redo/repair 对齐历史
requirements.actualUsage: 冻结快照中未见应用迁移被事后修改的证据

requirements.need: 迁移可回滚并支持演练
requirements.responsibility: migrator.rollback 支持 dryRun 与事务模式；不可逆时在定义中声明 irreversible
requirements.recommendedUsage: 提供真实 down() 或声明 irreversible:true，dry run 预览回滚范围
requirements.actualUsage: 应用迁移为一次性建表，未使用 down

requirementFit.reason: defineMigration + Builder + checksum/repair + rollback 覆盖建表、幂等种子、漂移检测与回滚；应用迁移直接使用官方路径。

usability.reason: Skill 提供可复制示例与 db repair/redo 命令；MigrationContext 明确 builder/query/repository 的取舍。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 把自包含、合并后不可变、seed 幂等等易错点前置说明，types 注释给出 query 与 repository 的判据。

design.reason: schema 只由迁移历史演进，校验和与迁移锁保证一致；结构与安装数据分离，dry-run 只读设计清晰。

reliability.reason: 迁移锁、事务包装、校验和漂移检测与条件化修复写入均实现完整，并对并发修改整批回滚。

modules.name: 服务端 API 路由与错误/校验契约（@nocobase/app-server）
modules.scope: 为文档中心提供自定义 /api 路由、统一错误体、输入校验与 OpenAPI 文档，并规范可选服务依赖的解析。
modules.limitations: 仅审阅 dist 产物与应用用法，未实际发起 HTTP 请求或运行生成的 OpenAPI 文档。

requirements.need: 提供业务自定义 API 路由
requirements.responsibility: defineApiRoutes 声明 scope:api 的 Hono 路由工厂，RouterProvider 在容器中挂载
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 server/routes 用 defineApiRoutes 返回 Hono，并把贡献加入应用路由列表
requirements.actualUsage: app/server/routes/index.ts 用 defineApiRoutes 注册 /documents 与根路由

requirements.need: 输入校验与统一错误体
requirements.responsibility: apiValidator 以 Standard Schema 校验，ApiError 按 AIP-193 输出 domain/reason/fieldViolations 与 request id
requirements.recommendedUsage: 每个 handler 前用 apiValidator 声明校验，抛 ApiError 或经 router.onError 转换领域错误
requirements.actualUsage: documents.ts 使用 describeRoute/apiValidator/apiErrorResponse 并安装 onError

requirements.need: 生成可核对的 API 文档
requirements.responsibility: describeRoute + resolver 与 dataResponse/listResponse/emptyResponse/apiErrorResponses 声明响应，插件不直接依赖 hono-openapi
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用响应助手声明 400/403/404 等标准错误与数据体
requirements.actualUsage: documents.ts 用 describeRoute 与响应助手声明 OpenAPI

requirements.need: 可选服务依赖的降级解析
requirements.responsibility: ServiceResolver 提供 has/resolveIfCreated，未注册时不会抛错
requirements.recommendedUsage: 可选插件缺失时用 has 或 resolveIfCreated 降级，不假定已注册
requirements.actualUsage: document-center provider 用 container.has(authorizationToken) 判断后注册

requirementFit.reason: 路由声明、AIP-193 错误体、Standard Schema 校验与 OpenAPI 文档齐全，应用文档路由直接受益。

usability.reason: 响应助手与 apiValidator 让常见形态一站式声明；错误码固定集合便于客户端分支。

agentFriendliness.reason: 类型化的 defineApiRoutes/AppRouterFactory 与固定错误码集合减少臆测；插件不直接依赖 hono-openapi。

design.reason: router 作为 service 而非应用本身，职责分离清晰；错误识别与重抛分层，未识别的错误保持 opaque 500。

reliability.reason: 校验失败在 handler 前回答并逐字段定位，错误识别分层重抛，request id 贯穿错误体。

modules.name: 客户端路由与覆盖层路由（@nocobase/app-client）
modules.scope: 声明应用/设置页面与子路由覆盖层（dialog/drawer），并处理页面级授权与覆盖层关闭。
modules.limitations: 未在浏览器中实际加载路由；覆盖层行为依据指引与源码判断，图像证据未做视觉复核。

requirements.need: 声明应用与设置页面路由
requirements.responsibility: defineAppRoutes/defineSettingsRoutes 冻结 parent app/settings 的导航路由贡献
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 client/routes.ts 声明页面与嵌套 children，不在页面组件里声明路由
requirements.actualUsage: app/client/routes.ts 使用 defineAppRoutes/defineSettingsRoutes 声明文档中心页面

requirements.need: 以子路由表达 dialog/drawer 覆盖层
requirements.responsibility: RouteDialog/RouteDrawer 的上下文由 useRouteOverlay 提供，路由匹配决定覆盖层是否存在
requirements.recommendedUsage: 父页放 <Outlet/>，子页渲染 RouteDialog，close 只在内部子组件调用
requirements.actualUsage: 应用曾在渲染 RouteDialog 的页面组件内调用 useRouteOverlay 导致路由崩溃，最终拆分为 Body/Footer 修复

requirements.responsibility: AppClientRouteAuthz 支持 skip/unrestricted/{resource,action}，子页面继承最近祖先页面值
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在首个页面声明 authz，子页面按需显式声明
requirements.actualUsage: 应用对设置页声明 settings:documentCenter/manage，员工页使用 skip

requirements.need: 生产环境不暴露开发路由
requirements.responsibility: defineDevRoutes 在 import.meta.env.PROD 下返回空并被 bundler 剔除
requirements.recommendedUsage: 开发工具用 defineDevRoutes 声明
requirements.actualUsage: 应用未声明 dev 路由

requirementFit.reason: 应用/设置路由与子路由覆盖层均有声明式 API，页面授权内建；覆盖层崩溃源于用法错误而非能力缺失。

usability.reason: 冻结的路由贡献与类型精简，但 useRouteOverlay 的上下文约束在运行时才以抛错暴露，误用代价高。

agentFriendliness.reason: overlay 指引给出错误示例与确切抛错文本，可据以自检；但需 Agent 主动阅读指引才能避免误用。

design.reason: 路由贡献冻结、导航顺序稳定、授权可继承、Dev 路由在生产构建中被剔除，边界清晰。

reliability.reason: 路由注册与生产守卫实现简单可验证；覆盖层误用会直接使路由不可加载，容错不足。

modules.name: AI 知识库与带引用问答（@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base / @nocobase/ai-employee）
modules.scope: 让员工用内部文档回答问题并引用具体文件与段落，在无依据时声明无依据，且不引用无权内容。
modules.limitations: 环境无 embedding 服务与向量数据库，无法实际运行框架知识库检索；判断基于源码、Skill 与应用侧替代实现。

requirements.need: 用内部文档回答并引用具体文件与段落
requirements.responsibility: 知识库按 enabled bases 与 topK/score 做向量检索，ai-employee 将 {knowledgeBaseData} 注入提示并要求据此回答
requirements.recommendedUsage: 配置 embedding 服务 + 向量数据库 + 存储磁盘 + 员工绑定，按 Skill 顺序完成并做命中测试设定 Score
requirements.actualUsage: 环境未提供 embedding 服务与向量数据库（llmServices 空、vectorDatabases 空、SQLite），应用自建确定性关键词检索并注入引用

requirements.need: 找不到依据时明确说明，不引用无权内容
requirements.responsibility: 检索按 score 阈值返回候选，空结果语义由调用方处理；知识库明确不是业务数据的授权边界
requirements.recommendedUsage: 把 Score 设在 miss 分数之上，回答层显式处理空/低置信，数据访问用授权过滤
requirements.actualUsage: 应用自建检索早期对无依据问题给出误导性引用，最终轮加入无依据处理

requirements.need: 按部门可见性过滤后再检索
requirements.responsibility: 授权插件负责数据边界，应用在检索前限定可读文档
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在检索前用授权上下文过滤可读文档，不把知识库当授权边界
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在 document-center provider/检索侧按部门过滤，未注册数据库或 composite 资源

requirementFit.reason: 框架知识库能提供带分数的检索与引用提示，但强依赖外部 embedding/向量服务；本环境缺失，需求只能以应用自建检索绕行交付。

usability.reason: Skill 把依赖链与坑点写得很细，但接入成本高（PostgreSQL+pgvector、embedding 服务、磁盘、员工绑定），缺链时检索静默返回空。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 提供命中测试与阈值设定方法，但开发过程未调用该 Skill，且默认 score 0.6 对部分模型偏低，误判风险高。

design.reason: feature/vector-store 分层清晰、可替换向量库、默认 topK/score 参数化；但检索仅有向量路径，缺少词法回退与空结果契约。

reliability.reason: 向量检索直接依赖外部 vectorStore，无 embedding 时返回空；没有结构化无结果信号，可靠性受外部服务制约。

modules.name: 授权与部门可见性（@nocobase/authorization / @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization）
modules.scope: 解析授权服务、在服务端路由与客户端页面执行权限判定，并发现可选授权能力。
modules.limitations: 未运行授权判定；依据核心库与插件源码、Skill 与应用声明判断。

requirements.need: 解析授权服务并按存在性降级
requirements.responsibility: authorizationToken 由 app-plugin-authorization 注册；未安装时应降级而非假定存在
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 container.has/resolve(authorizationToken) 判断，再注册权限相关资源
requirements.actualUsage: document-center provider 用 container.has(authorizationToken) 判断后 resolve

requirements.need: 服务端路由与动作鉴权
requirements.responsibility: authz.middleware() 将 authz 写入上下文，can/require 与 composite/数据库策略执行判定
requirements.recommendedUsage: 先 authentication.required() 再 authorization.middleware()，动作路由用 require/can，数据范围用数据库策略或 composite
requirements.actualUsage: documents.ts/shared.ts 使用 context.get(authz).require/can，设置项声明 manage 动作

requirements.responsibility: AppClientRouteAuthz 与 settings/composite 目录类型控制页面可见性
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在首个页面声明 authz，子页面继承，用 useCan 控制动作可见性
requirements.actualUsage: client/routes.ts 对设置页声明 settings:documentCenter/manage，员工页 skip

requirements.need: 发现并验证可选授权能力
requirements.responsibility: optional-capabilities 规定以已安装 Skill 为入口，找不到即视为不支持，找到也要验证运行时启用
requirements.recommendedUsage: 先定位 Skill，再按其说明验证包/注册/配置/迁移
requirements.actualUsage: 应用注册并配置 default-access/sharing-rules/restriction-rules 插件

requirementFit.reason: can/require/middleware/composite/snapshot 与 settings/pages 目录覆盖页面与动作边界，可支撑按部门可见性；应用选择在服务端按部门过滤。

usability.reason: 授权上下文与 can/require 语义直接，Skill 给出 boot 声明顺序与客户端 authz 继承规则；可选能力有明确入口。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确先读可选能力发现、不得臆造 API，并区分找到 Skill 与运行时已启用，可减少误用。

design.reason: 身份中间件、授权上下文、composite 资源与 grant 分层清晰；snapshot 只暴露允许的三元组，避免客户端越权展示。

reliability.reason: require 失败抛 AuthorizationDeniedError，middleware 强制解析 principal，授权服务以 token 注册并由容器管理生命周期。

findings.title: 迁移引擎以校验和与迁移锁保证 schema 历史可复现、可诊断
findings.detail: @nocobase/db 把 defineMigration 声明、MigrationContext（builder/query/repository）与执行器分离；执行器在迁移锁内运行、按 transaction 模式包裹事务，并对已执行任务的校验和漂移给出可执行的 nocobase db repair 指引，rollback/repair 的 dry-run 只读不加锁。
findings.impact: 应用与插件在同一套可审计历史下演进 schema，迁移被改动能被检测而非静默漂移。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持现有契约；可在 Skill 中补充 down()/irreversible 的更多示例。

findings.title: 统一的 AIP-193 错误契约与 Standard Schema 输入校验
findings.detail: app-server router 以 Google AIP-193 固定错误码集与 ApiError（domain/reason/fieldViolations/request id）统一 /api 错误体；apiValidator 在 handler 前用 Standard Schema 校验并把 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT 与逐字段 violations 声明到 OpenAPI。
findings.impact: 客户端可基于固定码集分支，业务路由的校验与错误处理一致、可文档化。
findings.suggestedChange: 继续以响应助手声明标准错误，避免插件各自发明错误体。

findings.title: 授权组合模型与可发现的可选能力
findings.detail: @nocobase/authorization 提供 can/require/authorize/snapshot 与 composite 资源，@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization 组合 permissionSets/database/pages/settings/ui 并注册主体；Skill 与 optional-capabilities 要求先定位已安装 Skill、再验证运行时启用。
findings.impact: 业务可在页面、动作与数据范围三个层级表达权限，扩展能力有章可循。
findings.suggestedChange: 在应用侧为文档可见性声明数据库或 composite 资源，使权限集中在授权模型内。

findings.title: 覆盖层指引明确到可自检
findings.detail: overlay.md 规定 RouteDialog/RouteDrawer 必须作为子路由，useRouteOverlay 只能在对话框内部组件调用，并给出错误示例与确切抛错 useRouteOverlay must be used inside RouteDialog or RouteDrawer，同时禁止自建 route-overlay 实现。
findings.impact: Agent 能在实现前对照指引避免整类路由崩溃。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持现状；可在示例旁补充一个正例完整文件。

processNotes.author: implementer
processNotes.summary: Fixed Document Center defects across three rounds: (1) two administration overlays crashed because they called useRouteOverlay() from the page component that renders the dialog instead of from a component inside it; (2) the employee document preview's version history omitted the modifier and (for a user who may manage the center) the restore action; (3) the Q&A retrieval cited unrelated paragraphs for questions the documents do not cover ("公司年会在哪里举办", "如何申请专利", "火星移民计划报名流程") instead of reporting no basis, caused by a single overlapping bigram passing the score floor and by crossing bigrams emitted across function characters. (4) the employee document preview resolved each version's modifier through the administrator-only /directoryUsers endpoint, so opening any preview answered 403 PERMISSION_DENIED and the modifier rendered as —; versions now carry createdByName from the server.

blockers.title: DocumentCenterProvider.boot() resolves the optional authorization service unconditionally
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > app server > registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime failed with `Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered.` at server/providers/document-center.ts:1429.
blockers.rootCause: The provider boot() unconditionally resolved authorizationToken and registered its settings section at startup, but that test assembles the runtime with an empty plugin list, so the authorization plugin never registered the token.
blockers.resolution: Guard the boot()-time UI registration with `this.app.container.has(authorizationToken)` and return early when the optional plugin is absent. When the plugin is registered (the real application) behavior is unchanged; the provider still registers its service in register().

blockers.title: Document version history overlay could not load (`useRouteOverlay` used outside its provider)
blockers.symptom: `/settings/document-center/documents/:documentId/versions` showed "Route document-center-document-versions ... could not be loaded" and the console error "useRouteOverlay must be used inside RouteDialog or RouteDrawer"; the administrator could not view or restore history versions.
blockers.rootCause: document-versions.tsx called useRouteOverlay() in the default-exported page component that returns `<RouteDialog>…</RouteDialog>`. useRouteOverlay reads the context that RouteDialog itself provides, so at that level there is no provider and the hook throws. Working overlays (document-form.tsx, department-form.tsx, document-edit.tsx) call it from a component rendered inside the dialog.
blockers.resolution: Split the page: DocumentVersionsPage now only renders `<RouteDialog title=… description=…><DocumentVersionsContent /></RouteDialog>`, and the new DocumentVersionsContent holds all state, useParams/useOutletContext and calls useRouteOverlay() from inside the dialog provider. No behavior other than the crash fix changed.

blockers.title: Document preview version history omitted the modifier and the restore action
blockers.symptom: In the document detail drawer the Version history list showed only "Version 2 — QA修改内容生成版本2" and the timestamp: no modifier and no way to restore an earlier version, so an administrator could not restore from the viewer they were using.
blockers.rootCause: document-preview.tsx rendered each version as `Version N — changeNote` plus the raw date. Unlike the admin document-versions.tsx, it never resolved createdById to a display name (via listDirectoryUsers) and never offered a restore. The preview route `/documents` is authz: 'skip' (open to every signed-in user) and the server's restore endpoint is behind requireManage(), so the restore action additionally had to be gated by the permission snapshot rather than by route authz.
blockers.resolution: Rewrote document-preview.tsx to fetch getDocument, listDocumentVersions and listDirectoryUsers in parallel (user directory best-effort: a 403 without `manage` yields '—' instead of failing the drawer). Each version now renders `documents.preview.versionMeta` = '{{modifier}} · {{date}}' and the change note; index 0 is marked current, and older versions show a Restore button only when useCan({ resource: { type: 'settings', id: 'documentCenter' }, action: 'manage' }).can, opening the shared restore-confirmation AlertDialog and calling restoreDocumentVersion from the admin locale copy. Added the `documents.preview.versionMeta` key to both en-US and zh-CN.

blockers.title: Backup restore overlay could not load (`useRouteOverlay` used outside its provider)
blockers.symptom: `/settings/document-center/backups/:backupId/restore` showed "Route document-center-backup-restore ... could not be loaded" with the same "useRouteOverlay must be used inside RouteDialog or RouteDrawer" console error, so the restore-impact list and confirmation were unavailable.
blockers.rootCause: Same as the versions overlay: backup-restore.tsx called useRouteOverlay() in the default-exported page component that returns `<RouteDialog>` instead of in a component rendered inside the dialog's provider.
blockers.resolution: Split BackupRestorePage into a thin wrapper that renders `<RouteDialog>…<BackupRestoreContent /></RouteDialog>` and a BackupRestoreContent that owns the impact state, useParams/useOutletContext and useRouteOverlay() call. The confirmed restore still reloads the backups list and closes the overlay.

blockers.title: Q&A retrieval cited unrelated paragraphs instead of reporting no basis
blockers.symptom: Employee questions the documents do not cover — "公司年会在哪里举办", "如何申请专利", "火星移民计划报名流程" — returned "Where this is answered" with unrelated paragraphs (行为准则, 合同主体, 报销流程, 出差申请) rather than the "No basis found in the documents you may read" message. Only a question with literally zero overlapping token ("如何用香蕉发射火箭去火星") reported no basis.
blockers.rootCause: retrieve() cited any paragraph whose occurrence-weighted score reached MIN_SCORE=2, and a single overlapping bigram (公司, 申请, 流程) is worth exactly 2, so one shared generic word was enough. The CJK bigram tokenizer also emitted crossing bigrams that run across function characters (年假有几天 → 假有/有几/几天; 公司年会在哪里举办 → 会在/在哪), so unrelated paragraphs shared many spurious tokens with the question.
blockers.resolution: Two changes in server/providers/document-retrieval.ts, no route or response-shape change. (a) tokenize() drops a CJK bigram that touches a function or interrogative/quantity character (new CJK_FUNCTION_CHARS set); bigrams built on compounding characters such as 请/要/会/专 survive. (b) retrieve() requires a paragraph to match at least MIN_MATCHED_TERMS=2 distinct question terms when the question has three or more distinct terms; one- and two-term questions still answer on a single match, which is what keeps "出差怎么报销" and "怎么请假" working. scoreParagraph() now also returns the count of distinct matched tokens.

blockers.title: Employee document preview resolved version modifiers through the administrator-only directory
blockers.symptom: Opening any document preview as a department employee triggered GET /api/directoryUsers?limit=100, which answered 403 AUTHORIZATION_DENIED ("No grant allows settings:documentCenter.manage"); the employee version history therefore showed every modifier as — while the administrator preview showed “Super Admin”. The same request is a non-expected 4xx inside the core employee preview flow.
blockers.rootCause: document-preview.tsx (and, redundantly, the admin document-versions.tsx) called listDirectoryUsers to map createdById to a display name. That endpoint is an admin route guarded by requireManage(), so a reader has no way to resolve the name; the client swallowed the failure (.catch(() => [])) and fell back to —.
blockers.resolution: Resolve the modifier on the server where the version list is produced. DocumentVersionView gained createdByName; DocumentCenterService.listVersions collects the versions' createdById values and looks up only those accounts in the user collection (guarded by builder.hasCollection('user') so a minimal runtime without it still renders). DocumentVersionSchema and the client DocumentVersion type gained createdByName, and both the employee preview and the admin versions page render version.createdByName, dropping the directoryUsers call entirely. The directory itself stays behind manage for the member picker.

improvements.title: Document the optional-plugin service-resolution pattern for application providers
improvements.detail: An application-owned provider that enhances an optional plugin resolved that plugin's service token unconditionally, so it only failed in the runtime test that starts the application without plugins.
improvements.suggestedChange: The application-development Skill could state that a provider resolving a service owned by an optional plugin guard the resolve with container.has(token), as the authorization plugin's own provider does for the database and realtime services.

improvements.title: Catch useRouteOverlay called outside its provider by test
improvements.detail: Two overlays shipped calling useRouteOverlay() in the page component that renders RouteDialog/RouteDrawer, which throws at render time and blanks the route. The mistake is invisible to type checking and only appears when the route is opened.
improvements.suggestedChange: Provide a reusable test harness (or a lint rule) that renders every overlay route through a real router and fails if the page component throws 'useRouteOverlay must be used inside RouteDialog or RouteDrawer'; the fix pattern is to move the hook into a content component rendered inside the overlay.

improvements.title: Test a keyword retriever with both supported questions and no-basis questions
improvements.detail: The retrieval tests only asserted one answerable question and a question with zero token overlap, so a retriever that cites any paragraph sharing one word passed all of them. The misleading answer only appeared for questions with partial, coincidental keyword overlap.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a feature claims to say 'no basis' rather than guess, require tests that pair supported questions with questions that share one common keyword but have no answer in the corpus.

improvements.title: A read path must not depend on an admin-only endpoint to render
improvements.detail: The employee preview degraded silently: a best-effort admin call behind a .catch hid a real authorization failure and left required data (the version modifier) blank.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a screen must show data for every signed-in reader, resolve it on the server route that the reader may already call (or expose a scoped read endpoint); do not paper over an admin-only dependency with .catch and a placeholder.

# Dialogs, drawers and confirmation dialogs

This document shows how to write overlays. For the rules on choosing and stacking overlays, see I1 in [`../ui-guidelines.md`](../ui-guidelines.md); for the form itself, see [`form.md`](form.md); for how to load data, see [`api.md`](api.md).

## 1. Choosing an overlay

| Use case                                                                   | Component                      | Where the open state lives |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------- |
| Create, edit (short form)                                                  | `RouteDialog` (child route)    | URL                        |
| Record detail view, inspector                                              | `RouteDrawer` (child route)    | URL                        |
| Child page that covers the content area (non-modal)                        | `RouteChildPage` (child route) | URL                        |
| Confirm one action (delete, deactivate, etc.)                              | `AlertDialog`                  | Component state            |
| Temporary panel that represents no record or location (explanations, help) | `Sheet`                        | Component state            |

- **Build dialogs and drawers that represent a page, form, editor or detail view as child routes by default**, even when the user does not mention "routing": a link opens them directly, a refresh restores them, and browser back and forward work. Follow an explicit user request for a different interaction.
- For these overlays, do not use an `open` state inside the component, do not add an `open` prop to `RouteDialog`/`RouteDrawer`, and do not build a separate route-overlay implementation. Route matching decides whether the overlay exists: the child route's URL opens it, and the parent route's URL closes it.
- **An overlay opens over the view the user is on** (guideline I9): the page, or on a page with tabs, the tab being shown. A record shown on a dashboard, a board or another record's tab opens the same drawer as in its list, declared under that page ([section 2.1](#21-declare-the-child-routes)). Never link to the list's overlay URL from another page, and never open a page's header overlay beside its tabs (["Overlays opened from the header of a page with tabs" in `child-routes.md`](child-routes.md#overlays-opened-from-the-header-of-a-page-with-tabs)).
- Only a confirmation of a single action (`AlertDialog`) and a temporary panel (`Sheet`) use component state.
- `RouteChildPage` covers the content area and is not modal, so the sidebar and header stay usable; see [`child-routes.md`](child-routes.md).
- Stacking: a drawer can open dialogs and confirmation dialogs on top of it; a dialog can open only a confirmation dialog on top of it. Esc and clicking the backdrop close only the topmost layer (guideline I1).
- This table replaces the overlay table of the shadcn skill, which gives record details to `Sheet` ([section 3 of `shadcn.md`](shadcn.md#3-where-this-application-departs-from-the-skill)).

Component locations: `@/components/route-dialog`, `@/components/route-drawer`, `@/components/use-route-overlay`, `@/components/ui/alert-dialog`, `@/components/ui/sheet`. The last two are not in the template; add them with `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add alert-dialog sheet` ([section 1 of `shadcn.md`](shadcn.md#1-what-the-template-ships-and-how-to-add-the-rest)).

## The dependency chain

Every link must exist before the next one works. A missing link rarely fails loudly: documents save and then sit in `ERROR`, or retrieval quietly returns nothing.

| #   | Link              | Where it is configured                                                                                 | Read when                        | Reference                                                                                                               |
| --- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Embedding service | `config.yml` → `ai.llmServices[]` with an embedding-capable `provider`                                 | startup and config reload        | [embedding-services.md](references/embedding-services.md)                                                               |
| 2   | Vector database   | `config.yml` → `ai.aiKnowledgeBase.vectorDatabases[]` (or `POST /api/aiKnowledgeBase/vectorDatabases`) | startup and config reload        | [vector-databases.md](references/vector-databases.md)                                                                   |
| 3   | Storage disk      | `drive.disks` + `ai.aiKnowledgeBase.storage.disk` (the allowlist)                                      | startup only                     | [storage-disks.md](references/storage-disks.md)                                                                         |
| 4   | Knowledge base    | a Manifest `init` (preferred), or AI settings / `POST /api/aiKnowledgeBases`                           | Manifest: startup only           | [manifests.md](references/manifests.md)                                                                                 |
| 5   | Documents         | Manifest `files`, or upload in AI settings / `POST /api/aiKnowledgeBase/documents`                     | vectorized after they are stored | [knowledge-bases-and-retrieval.md](references/knowledge-bases-and-retrieval.md)                                         |
| 6   | Employee binding  | AI settings → employee → Knowledge Base tab, or `PATCH /api/aiEmployees/{username}`                    | every chat turn                  | [knowledge-bases-and-retrieval.md](references/knowledge-bases-and-retrieval.md#bind-a-knowledge-base-to-an-ai-employee) |

A knowledge base stores the triple `vectorDatabaseKey` + `llmService` + `embeddingModel`. Those are names, not copies: renaming or removing the service or the vector database later breaks every knowledge base that names it.

## Prerequisites

1. **The plugin is installed and registered on both sides.** Commercial packages come from the NocoBase registry: `npm config set @nocobase:registry=https://npm.nocobase.ai`, with any authentication in the user's own npm configuration, never in a committed file. Then run `pnpm nocobase plugin register @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base` from the App root; it adds the dependency and the entries in `server/plugins.ts` (`/server`) and `client/plugins.ts` (`/client`), and synchronizes this Skill. Those two files are the registration.
2. **`@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee` is registered too**, before this plugin in both files. The default template already has it. This plugin resolves its AI manager and settings group; without it the App does not start.
3. **A PostgreSQL server with the `vector` extension is reachable.** It can be the App's own PostgreSQL or a separate one; the App's main database can stay SQLite. See [vector-databases.md § Prepare PostgreSQL](references/vector-databases.md#prepare-postgresql).
4. **The operator has AI settings access.** Every knowledge-base and vector-database action requires a session and the `page:ai.settings` / `access` grant, and answers `403` without it.
5. **The App composes the jobs service.** Vectorization runs as a background job on the application's jobs service, so `server/app.ts` must add `JobExecutorServiceProvider` from `@nocobase/app-server/jobs` and `server/config/index.ts` must include the `jobs` section, as current templates do; without the provider the App refuses to start with an error that names it. The `memory` adapter — also what runs when `jobs.default` is unset — serves one process. Before running more than one instance, set `jobs.default` to a `redis` configuration with a persistent Redis. The `queue` section plays no part in vectorization.
6. **The App mounts the Base UI toaster.** The settings pages report results through the App's Base UI toast, so `client/react-providers.ts` must mount the `toaster` provider from `client/components/ui/toast.tsx`, as current templates do. A page that fails with `Base UI: useToastManager must be used within <Toast.Provider>` is missing it; the `nocobase-app-upgrade` Skill's `references/edge-cases.md`, "Notifications and the Base UI toast", shows how to add it.

## Shortest end-to-end path

Do these in order; each step depends on the one before it. Prefer configuration over clicking: `config.yml` entries and Manifests are repeatable, reviewable, and survive a fresh database, while records created in the UI exist only in one database.

1. **Choose and prove an embedding model.** Reuse the App's chat service when its provider supports embeddings (`openai`, `openai-completions`, `google-genai`, `dashscope`, `mistral`, `ollama`); otherwise add a dedicated service. Settle where the key lives with the user as [secrets.md](references/secrets.md) describes, then prove the chosen model id with one embedding request. See [embedding-services.md](references/embedding-services.md).
2. **Prepare PostgreSQL and declare the vector database** in `config.yml` under `ai.aiKnowledgeBase.vectorDatabases`, with the password as `${NAME}`. Use one `tableName` per embedding model. Restart, read the log for skipped entries, then open AI settings → Vector databases and test the record. See [vector-databases.md](references/vector-databases.md).
3. **Decide the storage disk** for the knowledge base's files, and name it in `ai.aiKnowledgeBase.storage.disk`. Falling through to the App's default disk is a decision, not a neutral default — say which disk that is and ask. See [storage-disks.md](references/storage-disks.md).
4. **Create the knowledge base and its documents.** For content that should exist in every environment, write a Manifest (`operation: init`), list it under `ai.aiKnowledgeBase.manifests`, and tell the user what each target environment must receive by hand; for a one-off, create it in AI settings → Knowledge bases and upload there. See [manifests.md](references/manifests.md) or [knowledge-bases-and-retrieval.md](references/knowledge-bases-and-retrieval.md).
5. **Restart and wait for `SUCCESS`.** A Manifest runs only at startup. Open the knowledge base and confirm every document reaches `SUCCESS`; fix and re-vectorize any `ERROR` rather than uploading again.
6. **Run a hit test** with a sentence copied from a document, and once with an unrelated question to learn this model's score for a miss. If the original sentence does not come back first, the problem is upstream — status, embedding, vector database — not the `Score` threshold.
7. **Bind the knowledge base to the employee**: enable it, select the knowledge bases it should use (an empty selection means every enabled knowledge base), keep `{knowledgeBaseData}` in the prompt, start from `Top K = 3`, and set `Score` above the miss score the hit test showed — the default `0.6` is below it for some models. See [knowledge-bases-and-retrieval.md § Bind](references/knowledge-bases-and-retrieval.md#bind-a-knowledge-base-to-an-ai-employee).
8. **Verify by observation**, not by reading configuration back. Run the checks below.

## Safety

- A key or password never enters the repository or the conversation transcript. Follow [secrets.md](references/secrets.md): the user sets the value; the agent never asks for it, never writes it, refers to it only by variable name, and never prints the environment, `.env`, a shell profile, or a `config.yml` holding a value. The agent may load `.env` into a subshell for a single command under the limits that reference sets. `config.example.yml` carries `${NAME}` placeholders only.
- Vector database connections, including passwords, are stored in plain text in the plugin's table and in every backup of it. Give the vector database a PostgreSQL role scoped to its own database or schema.
- Never invent a provider key, a model id, a vector database key, or a disk name. A wrong provider key drops the service in silence; a wrong model id fails only at vectorization; a disk outside the allowlist is rejected when the knowledge base is created.
- Obtain explicit confirmation before deleting a knowledge base, a document or a vector database, before changing a knowledge base's vector database, service or model (existing vectors are not rebuilt), before re-vectorizing a whole knowledge base, and before pointing a vector database at a table that already exists.
- Knowledge-base content is readable by every employee bound to it and by every user who can chat with that employee. A knowledge base is not an authorization boundary for business data; the data tools and their grants are.
- Never write to the plugin's tables or deep-import plugin internals to finish an App task. If a public surface is genuinely missing, say so and stop.

## Completion checks

- The startup log has no `Invalid vector database configuration was skipped.` warning, and AI settings → Vector databases lists the configured key with a successful connection test.
- The knowledge base shows the intended disk, vector database, LLM service and embedding model.
- Every document is `SUCCESS`, with a non-zero segment count. None is left in `ERROR`.
- A hit test with a sentence copied from a document returns that document first, clearly above the score of an unrelated question, and the employee's `Score` sits between the two.
- In a chat with the bound employee, a question only the documents can answer is answered from them — ask it once with the knowledge base bound and once without, and compare.
- A second restart of the App imports nothing twice: the document count is unchanged and the server log shows no new Manifest warnings.
- When a Manifest is used: the user has been told, in writing, what each target environment needs — the Manifest YAML and its files on the source disk, and the `ai.aiKnowledgeBase` entries in that environment's `config.yml` — because none of it is packaged.
- `config.yml` and `.env` are ignored and untracked; `config.example.yml` documents every new entry with placeholders only.
- No App file imports a plugin private path, and no changed file lives under `.agents/skills/`.

Read [optional capability discovery](references/optional-capabilities.md) before using any rule plugin. A missing corresponding Skill means the capability is unsupported in the current App and needs separate development; do not assume its APIs or tables exist.

## Implement in this order

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

## Enforcement rules

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.database.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from the database; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- `settings`, `composite` and `database.collection` are catalog types: a check on an unregistered item or action is denied with `RESOURCE_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED`. `page`, `user`, `notification` and Hub types are record types that declare actions only; their grants use `id: '*'` for every record.
- A composite action composes exactly the grants it lists, never another composite. A data scope targets the one collection its grant actions name, whose type must declare `recordAccess` (`database.collection` does). Grant page access separately; a page grant never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require` needs an unconditional permit and rejects conditional decisions. Business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial or missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving collection grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the Repository route definition and bind each method to its composite action with `authz.database.authorizeRepository`. Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions need custom handlers. `authz.database.policyFor` folds collection grants; without its third argument it does not respect a business-action boundary.
- Scope every read and write in the workflow, including parent lookups. Keep multi-record writes transactional and include expected business state in mutation predicates. Authorization does not validate a quote's amount or its workflow transition.
- Fields and relation operations are code-owned. The permission workspace configures pages, business actions, their data scopes and settings items; do not build a second raw-field permission editor.

# Optional authorization capabilities

Permission sets, page authorization, composite declarations, workspace placement and database policy enforcement belong to the main authorization plugin. Default access, sharing rules and restriction rules are separate optional plugins.

| Requirement                                                       | Installed Skill                               |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| A common record baseline for holders of an action                 | `nocobase-app-plugin-authz-default-access`    |
| Additional records for selected collaborators who hold the action | `nocobase-app-plugin-authz-sharing-rules`     |
| Narrow granted records for selected subjects                      | `nocobase-app-plugin-authz-restriction-rules` |

Before designing with one of these capabilities, locate and read its Skill in the current App's `.agents/skills/`. If the corresponding Skill cannot be found, treat the capability as unsupported in this App and tell the user it requires separate development. Do not assume a rule plugin is present, invent an API, write its tables, or silently add a dependency/config factory. Continue independent work on supported capabilities; do not silently omit a required access boundary.

Finding the Skill is the development entry point, not proof of runtime activation. Follow that Skill to verify the package, client/server registrations, authorization configuration and migrations. A present but unconfigured plugin must be integrated according to its instructions before use.

Each owning Skill contains its installation, builders, service APIs, management routes, seed persistence and verification. Seeded business rules remain editable in the backend. The main Skill does not define optional-plugin storage contracts.

When configured, defaults and sharing add positive record scopes; restrictions narrow them. None grants a missing business action, page or field capability. Use the owning Skill for precise scope and relation boundaries.
